summary: User d.yilmaz@aegean.edu shows confirmed compromise indicators. A phishing email from aegean-edu.co (F1, T1566.002) preceded bulk Student Information System access (38 events in 60 min from 185.220.101.7; F2, T1213). Impossible travel Amsterdam→Manisa in 234 min (F3, T1078.004) and an API-created inbox forwarding rule to d.yilmaz.payroll@gmail.com (F5, T1114.003) indicate post-auth abuse. Risk Gate verdict: contain (confidence 0.75). Password-spray allegation rejected due to shared-NAT background noise.
